reason: Both open with the identical, correct emergency stop (no relighting, no switches, ECV off, ventilate, leave, call 0800 111 999). Conversation 1 then handles the panicked follow-up well: it confirms turning off at the outside meter with clear quarter-turn instructions, keeps the customer out of the kitchen, tells them to call from outside and what to report, forbids relighting or restoring gas, and correctly defers any ignition/gas-control diagnosis to the emergency and Gas Safe engineer. Conversation 2 ends after the first turn, so it never addresses the customer's direct question about the meter, the rented-home constraint, or the ongoing strong smell; it is not wrong, just less complete.
